name: CP 55,940
summary: CP 55,940 is a synthetic cannabinoid which mimics the effects of naturally occurring THC (one of the psychoactive compounds found in cannabis). CP 55,940 was created by Pfizer in 1974 but was never marketed. It is currently used as a research tool to study the endocannabinoid system.

pharmacology.text: CP 55,940 is 45 times more potent than Δ9-THC, and fully antagonized by rimonabant (SR141716A). It is considered a full agonist at both CB1 and CB2 receptors and has Ki values of 0.58 nM and 0.68 nM respectively, but is an antagonist at GPR55, the putative "CB3" receptor. CP 55,940 binding has been detected in the cytosol of rat brain cerebral cortex. It can upregulate 5-HT2A receptors in mice.

uses.text: CP 55,940 was created by Pfizer in 1974 but was never marketed. It is currently used as a research tool to study the endocannabinoid system.

summaryZh: CP 55,940是一種有機化合物，分子式C24H40O3，為四氫大麻酚的類似物，1974年由輝瑞研發。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: CP 55,940 helped scientists find the cannabinoid receptor. In 1988 researchers used a radioactive version of it to show that the brain has specific binding sites for cannabinoids.
fact.zh: CP 55,940 幫助科學家找到了大麻素受體。1988 年，研究人員利用它的放射性標記版本，證明大腦中有專門結合大麻素的位置。
fact.zhHans: CP 55,940 帮助科学家找到了大麻素受体。1988 年，研究人员利用它的放射性标记版本，证明大脑中有专门结合大麻素的位置。
